full_details: Morning prayer ran its length. The journal keeps the opening, and the rest of the sermon is a gap. Sir John Spencer gave one response in the litany and did not speak to you. At the board Mistress Ansell called the jaw a quince and named a barber at a shilling. You said after Thursday, and you meant the king. Verbeke offered a thread and a door. Alse left, and came back with sops. Upstairs you wrote Anne six lines for the carrier. The margin is the one that says to trust the boy. Of the tooth you told her only that you have one. You did not mention the Mayor's letter. In the evening you looked at the struck sheet and left the margin where it stood.
one_sentence: You kept St Michael with a hand on your jaw, took the board's verdict, and wrote Anne six lines about Saturday's margin.
title: The jaw called a quince, and six lines to Anne
